7-inch Metal Triangle Ruler Product Description

Product Overview

This 7-inch metal triangle ruler is manufactured from high-quality aluminum alloy material. It is printed with both metric and imperial dual scales, equipped with standard 90-degree, 45-degree angles. This tool integrates measuring, marking and scribing functions, widely used for woodworking marking, architectural drawing, engineering layout and DIY handcraft projects.

Silver and black color options are available, suitable for hardware stores, wholesale distribution and cross-border bulk orders.

Key Features

  1. Dual Metric & Imperial Graduations

    Clear engraved metric and imperial scales on the surface, meeting different measuring habits. The scale will not wear off after long-term repeated use, convenient for domestic and overseas workers to read data quickly.

  2. Sturdy Aluminum Alloy Structure

    Made of premium aluminum alloy, lightweight yet durable. Wear-resistant, anti-rust and not easy to deform. It can withstand frequent outdoor and workshop use, offering long service life.

  3. Standard 90° & 45° Angle Design

    Built-in precise 90-degree right angle and 45-degree angle. Ideal for drawing vertical lines, horizontal lines and diagonal scribing. Perfect for checking verticality, marking cutting lines during woodworking operation.

  4. Wide Application Range

    Suitable for woodworking, construction, engineering drawing, home renovation and manual DIY tasks. Great for carpenters, architects, students and hobbyists. Multiple colors support diversified market demands.
